scope: Pin server-owned patch identity in the new Specialist output schema while preserving historical requests and all backend guards.
riskAnalysis: Trial6 stopped at exact source validation after HTTP200. Original wrong digest was not retained. New-task singleton enums prevent identity transcription errors; this is not proof of the original model value.

threatModel.assets: Exact source and task identity, immutable historical evidence, request limits and isolated-test authority.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Model returns inert source proposal; only server supplies identity constants and separately validates every field before disposable application.
threatModel.abuseCases: Foreign source/task/workspace identity, shared-schema contamination, stale policy activation, instruction injection and oversized requests.
threatModel.mitigations: Deep-cloned per-request schema, exact singleton identity enums, unchanged direct backend checks, historical golden request hashes and unchanged request ceilings.

defects.rootCause: Live Specialist source digest failed exact validation; model-emitted server metadata was constrained only by a bounded string schema. Original value is unknown.
defects.detectionGap: Fixtures copied exact server metadata; earlier generic mismatch location did not identify the source digest field.
defects.regression: Both-adapter identity constants, fresh contexts, historical request golden hashes, direct backend denials and complete five-stage fixture criticism.
defects.historicalPrevention: Derive identity constants from verified task context and validate live identity output independently from generated engineering content.

rollback: Disable new execution, revert only this feature repair if qualification fails; never reuse consumed grants or rewrite historical receipts.

proactiveReview.architecture: Reuse existing adapter, patch contract and exact-release controller. No new orchestration, journal or credential system.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No package or infrastructure changes; no new access or spending authority.
proactiveReview.threats: Cross-context schema mutation, stale approval reactivation, forged metadata and output-size regressions receive explicit adversarial coverage.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Wrong metadata is denied at strict schema and backend boundaries; immutable usage and cleanup remain independent of acceptance.
